description: This Java class 'DefaultWebsocketConfig' implements the 'WebsocketConfig' interface, providing configuration settings for WebSocket connections such as backpressure queue sizes, throttling rejection factor, and associated throttling configuration. It includes methods for instantiation from a Config object, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultWebsocketConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing WebsocketConfig, encapsulating WebSocket configuration parameters such as backpressure queue sizes, throttling rejection factor, and throttling configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultWebsocketConfig from a given Config object, applying fallback and configuration values.

methods.name: getSubscriberBackpressureQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the configured size of the subscriber backpressure queue.

methods.name: getPublisherBackpressureBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the configured size of the publisher backpressure buffer.

methods.name: getThrottlingRejectionFactor
methods.description: Returns the throttling rejection factor used for rate limiting.

methods.name: getThrottlingConfig
methods.description: Returns the ThrottlingConfig object associated with this WebSocket configuration.
